urdu: کس سال میں لاہور ٹیم نے پاکستان کی فرسٹ کلاس کرکٹ میں حصہ لینا شروع کیا؟
english: In which year did the Lahore team start participating in Pakistan's first-class cricket?
roman_1: Kis saal mein Lahore team ne Pakistan ki first-class cricket mein hissa lena shuru kia?
roman_2: Kis sal me Lahore team ne Pakistan ki first-class cricket me hissa lena shuru kiya?
roman_3: Kis saal may Lahore team ne Pakistan ki first class cricket mein hissa lena shuru kya?
